data.name: Chaos Rider
data.detailed_description:
Chaos Rider is an epic Metroidvania where you awaken as an ancient spirit sealed for ages, now reborn in a powerful robotic body.

Return to a fractured world to unleash a new era of magic. Explore a vast, interconnected island filled with forgotten ruins, deadly dangers, and ancient secrets. Battle the ruthless Inquisitors who guard the critical sources of power that shape reality itself.

Master fluid movement and devastating abilities Dash, grapple, and upgrade your robotic form with powerful tools and armors and fusions. Adapt your playstyle on the fly as you overcome challenging platforming, solve environmental puzzles, and reach previously unreachable areas.

Fast-paced, customizable combat Crush hordes of enemies and epic bosses using a deep arsenal of weapons, weapon mods, and devastating abilities. Dodge through enemies with precision and stomp your foes into oblivion.

Forge your own Chaos Rider Mix and match weapons, mods, fusions, armors, and many other upgrades to create a unique playstyle. Find strange allies, experiment with powerful combinations and evolve your robotic vessel to conquer and liberate the realm from the inquisitors.

Key Features

  • Massive non-linear world full of secrets and multiple paths

  • Deep customization with  tools, augments, weapons, armors, mods and fusions

  • Fluid, momentum-based movement with many movement upgrades

  • Rich combat system with many upgrades and playstyles

  • Countless enemies and many boss fights

  • Satisfying growth of power to conquer harder challenges

  • Mysterious allies, creatures, and a living world to discover

data.short_description: The crazy plan to revive an ancient spirit has finally succeeded. The Chaos Rider is here to restore an age of magic to this fallen world. With a powerful adaptive robotic body and ancient powers, explore, forge alliances, conquer foes and challenges, and uncover countless secrets and wonders.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:

  • Processor: Ryzen 2200g
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GT1030
  • DirectX: Version 9.0
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: 16:9 recommended
